title: DFS and Shadow Copies
goal: One path to all shares; users can restore their own files.
built: A DFS namespace, \\nova.corp\shares, in front of the five department shares
Shadow Copies on the data volume, daily at 07:00 and 12:00
validated: I restored a deleted file from Previous Versions, and took the IT and Sales folder targets offline to show that one target per folder is not high availability.
